name: KENT Industrial Co.,Ltd.
summary: KENT Industrial Co.,Ltd. is a global enterprise dedicated to the engineering, manufacturing, and distribution of high-precision industrial machinery, specialized tooling, and related industrial components. With operations extending across Taiwan, Asia, the United States, and other international markets, the company provides a diverse array of sophisticated equipment. Its extensive product lineup includes various grinding machines, such as conventional and CNC surface grinders, CNC universal cylindrical grinders, deep-cut and slow feed grinders, and fixed double column surface grinders. Additionally, KENT offers vertical and fixed double column machining centers. Beyond its core machinery, the company's activities encompass the production and sale of a wide range of industrial tools and accessories, molds, dies, and hardware tools. It further specializes in manufacturing advanced digital control machine tools, high-pressure spindles, precision molds, precision stamping presses, and various industrial parts. The firm's capabilities also extend to the fabrication of metal alloy components and the supply of castings. To support its offerings, KENT Industrial provides comprehensive after-sales maintenance and expert consulting services. Established in 1966, KENT Industrial Co.,Ltd. is headquartered in Douliu City, Taiwan.
